title: Linear saving in high exact-order binary Hayes trace layers
statement: Let ell>=200, n in {2ell+1,2ell+2}, c=ceil(log2 ell), a=ell-c-1, and Q be the largest power of two with 3cQ<=ell. For every a<=j<=ell and every nonempty Hayes character family X_(j,s) of exact conductor j and exact order 2^s>Q, 4ell times the absolute signed trace sum over X_(j,s) is at most |X_(j,s)|(j-1)2^ceil(n/2).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; ADR-0592 high-order reduction

notes: This strictly weakens the earlier all-order factor-4ell conjecture. Together with F:gf2-hayes-low-exact-orders-weil-suffice and the degree-400 handoff it settles both Lemire endpoints. Finite Galois-order rows are falsification controls only.
